igvirnm.desc: Designed and executed attraction campaigns for iGV IR & M at AIESEC in SLIIT, connecting purpose-driven youth to international volunteering opportunities.
paras: AIESEC in SLIIT’s iGV (Incoming Global Volunteer) programme connects Sri Lankan youth with international volunteering experiences that create real-world social impact. As part of the IR & M (International Relations and Marketing) team, I was responsible for shaping the visual identity of our attraction campaigns. The goal was to create content that could stand out on social media while speaking directly to purpose-driven students.
The challenge was to balance AIESEC’s global brand guidelines with a tone that felt local, personal, and compelling enough to drive sign-ups during a highly competitive recruitment period.

steps.x: Studied AIESEC’s global brand guidelines and reviewed past campaigns from other local committees. Defined a tone that was youthful, purposeful, and bold, while identifying the most effective platforms and formats to maximise reach.

Developed a visual direction centred on contrast and urgency, using vibrant accent colours against dark backgrounds and a strong typographic hierarchy to guide attention toward the call to action. Created mood boards before moving into design.

Built a modular system of templates in Figma to ensure speed and consistency across the team. Each post followed a structured grid, allowing flexibility in content while maintaining a cohesive visual identity throughout the campaign.

Refined designs based on feedback from the iGV IR & M VP and AIESEC in Sri Lanka’s national standards. Final assets were approved and published across Global WhatsApp groups and Instagram during the peak attraction period.

outcomes.x: Campaign posts consistently outperformed organic benchmarks, expanding visibility for AIESEC in SLIIT’s iGV programme across campus.
Developed a reusable design framework that enabled the team to create future campaign content efficiently while maintaining brand consistency.
Assets were deployed across WhatsApp and Instagram with platform-specific adaptations, ensuring a consistent visual identity across all touchpoints.
Contributed to achieving the iGV IR & M team’s attraction target for the cycle, connecting more students to international volunteering opportunities.

nlds.desc: Designed a series of application creatives for the National Leadership Development Seminar (NLDS) Organising Committee selection, focused on presenting ideas with clarity, creativity, and strong visual storytelling.
paras: The National Leadership Development Seminar (NLDS) is a flagship AIESEC experience focused on developing leadership among members across the country. As part of my application for the Organising Committee, I created a series of visual assets to communicate ideas, showcase creativity, and demonstrate my approach to campaign design.

The challenge was to present concepts in a way that was both visually engaging and strategically clear, while aligning with AIESEC’s brand guidelines. The content needed to stand out, communicate intent effectively, and reflect my ability to contribute to a high-impact national event.

rows.v: Social posts · Concept visuals · Presentation graphics

steps.x: Studied AIESEC’s brand guidelines and reviewed past national event content to understand expectations. Defined a tone that was bold, clear, and aligned with leadership-focused messaging.
Explored visual directions that reflected energy and impact, using strong typography and contrast to emphasise key messages. Developed initial concepts before moving into design.
Created a series of cohesive assets that showcased both creativity and structure. Focused on clarity, layout balance, and visual consistency across all pieces.
Iterated on designs to improve clarity, alignment, and overall presentation, ensuring each asset effectively communicated its intended message.

outcomes.x: Showcased the ability to translate ideas into strong visual concepts that communicate clearly and effectively.
Demonstrated an understanding of aligning design decisions with purpose, audience, and context.
Maintained a cohesive style across all assets while exploring different creative directions.
Presented a well-structured and visually engaging application that highlighted both creative and strategic capabilities.

catalyst.desc: Designed promotional content for Catalyst 5.0, AIESEC in SLIIT's Leadership Development Seminar, focused on engaging participants and driving attendance through cohesive visual storytelling.
paras: Catalyst 5.0 is AIESEC in SLIIT’s flagship Leadership Development Seminar, designed to inspire and develop future leaders. As Organising Committee Vice President for Marketing, I was responsible for leading the overall marketing direction and execution of the event.

The campaign was built around an Avatar: The Last Airbender-inspired theme, using familiar elements and storytelling to create a strong emotional connection with the audience. The challenge was to translate this concept into a cohesive visual identity while maintaining alignment with AIESEC’s brand guidelines and ensuring the campaign remained engaging, relevant, and effective in driving participation.

rows.v: Social posts · Promotional graphics · Campaign assets

steps.x: Analyzed past event campaigns and aligned with AIESEC’s brand guidelines. Defined a direction that combined leadership messaging with a strong thematic identity.
Built the campaign around an Avatar-inspired concept, translating elements of storytelling, character, and progression into a visual and narrative direction that resonated with the audience.
Led the creation of campaign assets, ensuring consistency across all platforms. Focused on strong typography, visual hierarchy, and thematic elements to maintain a cohesive identity.
Refined assets based on team feedback and rolled out the campaign across Instagram, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms during the event promotion phase.

outcomes.x: Delivered a visually distinctive campaign that captured attention and increased interest in the event.
Successfully translated a pop culture theme into a cohesive campaign while maintaining alignment with brand guidelines.
Supported event visibility and participation through consistent and engaging content across multiple platforms.
Demonstrated the ability to lead marketing efforts, manage creative direction, and deliver a complete campaign experience.

goldcoin.desc: Developed flyers and email banners for A Company's Gold Coin Award Ceremony, supporting event communication by presenting the agenda and announcements with clarity and visual consistency.
paras: This project involved designing posters and invitation materials for a large-scale corporate award ceremony hosted by a leading organization in the apparel industry. The objective was to create visuals that reflected the prestige of the event while communicating key information clearly and effectively.

The challenge was to balance professionalism with visual appeal, ensuring that every asset aligned with corporate standards while still feeling engaging. The designs needed to maintain a high level of clarity, hierarchy, and consistency across both print and digital formats.

steps.x: Reviewed the event requirements and corporate branding expectations to understand the tone and level of formality required.
Explored clean and structured design directions that emphasized hierarchy, readability, and a sense of prestige suitable for an award ceremony.
Developed posters and invitation materials with a focus on typography, spacing, and layout to ensure clarity across both print and digital formats.
Refined designs based on feedback, ensuring alignment with expectations before finalizing assets for distribution.

outcomes.x: Delivered polished, high-quality designs aligned with corporate standards and expectations.
Ensured all event information was presented with strong hierarchy and readability across formats.
Maintained a cohesive look and feel across all collateral, reinforcing the prestige of the event.
Successfully met the expectations of a high-profile corporate client, demonstrating reliability and attention to detail.

merch.desc: Designed a range of merchandise including t-shirts and jackets, translating brand identity into wearable designs for events, membership, and personal creative exploration.
paras: This work focused on creating merchandise for AIESEC in SLIIT, alongside a selection of personal apparel designs. The goal was to translate brand identity and ideas into wearable formats that felt both visually appealing and meaningful to the audience.

The challenge was to design graphics that worked effectively on fabric, balancing creativity with practicality. Each piece needed to be visually strong, adaptable across different apparel types, and aligned with the intended audience, whether for events, members, or personal expression.

rows.v: T-shirt graphics · Jacket designs · Print-ready artwork

steps.x: Explored existing merchandise trends, brand guidelines, and visual references to understand what resonates in apparel design.
Developed design concepts that balanced creativity with wearability, focusing on bold visuals, typography, and placement.
Created graphics tailored for apparel, ensuring scalability, print clarity, and adaptability across different formats such as t-shirts and jackets.
Iterated on designs to improve composition, readability, and overall visual impact, preparing final outputs for production.

outcomes.x: Translated brand identity into wearable designs that resonate with members and event participants.
Showcased versatility through a mix of organizational and personal design styles.
Delivered designs optimized for real-world application, considering print, placement, and material constraints.
Created bold and engaging apparel pieces that stand out while remaining cohesive and wearable.

bio: I'm a creative designer with a passion for turning ideas into impactful visual experiences. With a background in digital design, content, and branding, I focus on creating work that is not only visually engaging but also purposeful and results-driven. From campaign design to event branding, I aim to craft solutions that connect with people and communicate with clarity.

From building campaigns to shaping event identities, I've worked across a range of creative spaces where strategy meets execution. I've developed digital content, promotional materials, and branded assets with a focus on consistency and audience engagement, aiming to create visuals that communicate effectively and leave a lasting impression.
